explication: ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts is an extension of ComfyUI with Python custom nodes and browser-side graph and workflow enhancements. Users work in the ComfyUI graph: they configure prompts and nodes, inspect or arrange graph content, and receive generated-image or execution feedback. The repository also provides model information, workflow management, and image utilities. The entry point dynamically loads Python node modules; browser modules register UI features. Relationships between unsampled feature modules are not inferred beyond documented capabilities.
